subject: Post-demo pricing & target $/1M token benchmarks — MedSync
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@medsync.health>
Cc: MedSync Procurement <procurement@medsync.health>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo pricing & target $/1M token benchmarks — MedSync

Hi Olivia — thanks again for taking the demo call this morning. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can align on pricing targets and next steps.

TL;DR: We need (1) your expected monthly token volumes by use case, (2) target budget range for the first 12 months, and (3) whether you track pricing targets as $/1M prompt+completion tokens or prefer a per-conversation estimate. Also: any benchmark targets you want us to use vs OpenAI/Anthropic/other managed hosts?

What I captured from the call: 
- Primary use case: clinical triage + patient messaging (higher prompt volume, short completions)
- Pilot goal: 500k to 2M conversations/month -> estimated tokens uncertain (you mentioned heavy short prompts)
- Security: must run in VPC private deployment for PHI; procurement will request SOC2 evidence

Immediate asks (can reply inline):
1) Volume breakout: rough monthly token estimate by use case (triage vs messaging). If you only have conversation counts, give an average tokens per convo (prompt/completion).
2) Annual pilot budget band (e.g., $50k–$150k) — helps me propose the correct Dedicated/reserved profile vs hosted credits.
3) Target unit price: what would you consider a defensible target $/1M tokens to justify switching from your current host? If you don’t have a target, tell us current host and effective $/1M if available.

I attached a one-page pricing slate and a blank cost-model template to make it easy to drop numbers in. If you prefer, we can run a quick mapping session with engineering to turn your conversation numbers into a token forecast (15–20 min).

Next steps I propose:
- You send the token/conversation estimates + budget band by end of week
- We produce a 2-option pricing grid (hosted + dedicated) showing $/1M comparisons vs OpenAI and Anthropic and an estimated monthly bill for your pilot
- Optional: schedule 20-min mapping session with our Platform Engineer to validate tokenization assumptions

Thanks again — I’ll hold a draft pricing grid until I have your volumes.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-pricing-slate.pdf (pdf), medsync-volume-estimates.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Olivia Park <olivia@medsync.health>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 17:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo pricing & target $/1M token benchmarks — MedSync

Thanks Mina — good summary. Quick answers inline below.

1) Volume breakout:
- Clinical triage: 120k conversations/month; average ~120 tokens total (prompt+completion)
- Patient messaging (reminders/2-way): 450k conversations/month; average ~60 tokens total
- Admin workflows (rare): 30k conv/month; ~200 tokens

Total estimated tokens/month: ~120k*120 + 450k*60 + 30k*200 = ~21.6M tokens/month (ballpark).

2) Budget band: For pilot year we have an initial budget of $80k–$140k; if pricing is compelling we can expand for a Q3 production roll.

3) Target unit price: We’re evaluating cost per 1M tokens vs our current managed host (we get billed effectively ~$20–$25 per 1M with volume discounts). If Redwood can get into the $10–$15/1M range with VPC option and comparable latency, that would be attractive.

Current host: OpenAI (mix of standard GPT-4-ish endpoints + an Anthropic pilot).

Attached RFP and a small CSV with conversation counts. Happy to do the mapping session — available Wed morning PST.

—Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Product, MedSync Health
procurement@medsync.health

Attachments: medsync-rfp.pdf (pdf), medsync-volume-estimates.xlsx (xlsx)

I attached their RFP + estimates. Planning to deliver a concise 2-option price grid and a one-pager on SOC2 / evidence next day. Can we sync 30m this afternoon?

Thanks — Mina

Hi Olivia — thanks for the quick numbers, super helpful. Attached is a concise two-option pricing grid (hosted trial vs Dedicated VPC reserved) and a simple mapping that turns your convo counts into token forecasts. Highlights: 

- Conservative estimate (safe tokenization, median completion lengths): ~22M tokens/month -> Hosted: $28/1M effective (with trial credits applied) -> Dedicated VPC (reserved 3-month pilot): $13/1M effective
- Aggressive estimate (tight tokenization, batching & caching gains): ~18M tokens/month -> Hosted: $34/1M effective (lower host discounts) -> Dedicated VPC (reserved): $10/1M effective

Notes and assumptions in the attached: include 10% overhead for PHI+VPC, 20% savings from KV caching for messaging patterns, and no additional NLU pre-processing token counts. SOC2 evidence & deployment checklist attached as a one-pager.

Next actions:
1) Review the attached grid and call out any off assumptions by EOD Thu (we can iterate)
2) If you want the $10–$15/1M demonstration, propose a short pilot commit (3 months reserved capacity) so we can lock pricing and capacity. I can draft the mutual action plan and a short T&Cs addendum for private deployments.
3) Schedule the 20-min mapping session — I’m available Wed 09:00–11:00 PST or Thu 13:00–15:00 PST.

If that looks good I’ll route a small commercial proposal to procurement and include the SOC2 checklist.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.inference
